note: Regional coverage register. 'verified' records are added only after a competent engineer has checked the app's values against the edition of the code in force in that country. Until then a country is not marked ready to sell.

notOffered.Russia: Not offered: UK/US/EU sanctions – payment providers will not process sales and services should not be supplied.

paymentNotes.Iraq: Check payment-provider support and sanctions screening before selling.

nationalDeviations.Germany: DIN VDE 0100 deviations (e.g. VDE-AR-N 4100 metering, RCD rules) to be checked.
nationalDeviations.France: NF C 15-100 prescriptive rules for dwellings (points per circuit, circuit types) to be checked.
nationalDeviations.Spain: REBT ITC-BT rules (ITC-BT-25 circuits) to be checked.
nationalDeviations.Italy: CEI 64-8 national annexes to be checked.
nationalDeviations.India: IS 732 / CEA regulations and NBC 2016 to be checked.
nationalDeviations.South Africa: SANS 10142-1 specific rules to be checked.
nationalDeviations.United Arab Emirates: DEWA / ADDC / SEWA authority regulations to be checked.
nationalDeviations.Saudi Arabia: Saudi Building Code SBC 401 to be checked.
nationalDeviations.Nigeria: Nigerian Electricity Regulatory Commission and DISCO requirements to be checked.
